prompt:
Portrait 9:16 cinematic dimensional storybook-animation, luxury outdoor mountain-to-beach wedding. Preserve adult Indian faces, medium-brown skin and natural proportions. DRAMATIC LIGHT: diagonal volumetric sunshafts through waterfall or sea mist, deep sculpted shade, bright fabric rim light, moving caustic reflections; at night cyan moonbeams balance amber practical pools. Modern coastal typography: elegant editorial serif with restrained handwritten accents, pearl-white headlines, deep ocean-teal body copy, brushed-platinum edges, fine cyan glow; no ornate antique lettering. Distinct natural locations, expensive site-specific decor. Cars are parked, wheels fixed; everyone has planted feet. Only camera, environment and subtle gestures move. Tiny mist beads, windborne grass seeds or coastal bubbles hang at varied depths, never a confetti storm. Text-only image, no watermark or extra words.

Adult Indian groom, visibly polished storybook 3D animation, warm medium-brown skin, slender adult oval face, large dark-brown almond eyes, thick dark eyebrows, smooth clean-shaven cheeks and chin, swept wavy black hair with a prominent side part and raised quiff, small relaxed smile. No moustache or beard. Natural adult proportions, not a child. Modern ivory linen tailored suit, open-collar white shirt, pale sage pocket square, tan loafers. No dhoti or bare chest. Preserve identity and outfit throughout the ceremony.

Adult Indian bride, polished storybook animation, warm medium-brown skin, graceful oval face, dark-brown almond eyes, gently arched black brows, small red bindi, reserved smile, center-parted dark hair in a low bun. Same adult face, age, skin tone and body throughout.Modern ivory satin wedding gown, fitted bodice, flowing skirt and short sheer veil pinned to the same low bun, pearl earrings and a small white orchid bouquet. No sari or traditional ceremonial costume. She stands on the raised platform.

SCENE COMPOSITION:
THREE-QUARTER view of a high-production daylight destination wedding on a broad RAISED ivory platform, clearly 60 cm above the sand with two broad steps and a silk-lined edge. The bride and groom stand on the LEFT on the platform, feet planted, hands gently joined, exchanging a tiny smile. No floor seating, rug ceremony, priest or ritual fire. A lavish asymmetric sculptural backdrop of curved ivory fabric sails, layered pearl linens, dense white orchids, pale hydrangeas and sage foliage stands behind them, with intentional gaps showing the sea. Expensive upholstered ivory seats, crystal cylinders, a brushed-platinum console and low orchid islands complete the setup; all firmly grounded. On RIGHT, ONE frosted-acrylic timing panel with deep-teal editorial serif copy and pearl-lit border reads exactly 'Wedding Ceremony
7th February 2020
8:00 a.m.
In the Morning'. Every word is readable. Open ocean horizon and blue sky dominate beyond this single destination setup; do not enclose the beach. Side sunshafts rake through sea mist, bright gown rim and suit texture contrast with cool shade. A few tied silk ribbons flex slowly, twelve small iridescent bubbles and fine spray beads drift independently at varied depths. The rocky headland remains visible to the right, with a coastal footpath leading toward it. No car at this ceremony.
